items.label: Lay the groundwork
items.description: Define your wedding vision: style, vibe, type of ceremony.

items.label: Estimate your guest count
items.description: Even a rough number will guide your logistics and budget choices.

items.label: Calibrate your budget
items.description: Assess your means and prioritize the items that matter most to you.

items.label: Pick a period or a target date
items.description: It dictates venue and vendor availability.

items.label: Book your key vendors
items.description: Venue, caterer, photographer first. Then DJ, decor, entertainment, etc.

items.label: Handle the official paperwork
items.description: City hall, religious or secular ceremonies, contracts, insurance, etc.

items.label: Anticipate wedding-day coordination
items.description: Plan a coordinator (recommended), beauty prep, logistics (transport, accommodations) and key moments.

items.label: Prepare your personal items
items.description: Outfits, rings, accessories, stationery, DIY or personal touches.

items.label: Consolidate your organization
items.description: Review every detail with your vendors: timing, deliveries, technical needs, final adjustments.

items.label: Live your day to the fullest
items.description: You've planned everything: now it's time to enjoy 100%!
